function: Excluded (system): over-the-air FL aggregation of zeroth-order scalar updates over a fading channel with one scalar coefficient h_i,t per UE, i.e., single-antenna UEs and server, no RIS (p. 2).
notes: Passes checks 1-5: research letter proposing ZOTA, zeroth-order federated LLM tuning whose scalar finite differences are aggregated over the air, so its function is area 7 (p. 2: "via OTA computations, each UE modulates its own unique local updates onto orthonormal waveforms"). Excluded at check 6 (system), which covers area 7: the link is single-antenna with no RIS. p. 2: "hi,t is the channel fading experienced by client i"; "we assume the channel fading is i.i.d. across UEs, with mean μh and variance σh2"; Eq. (3) aggregates scalars h_i,t Δ_i,j + ξ_t. p. 4: "For wireless channels, we set μh = 1 and σh = 0.1." The paper has no antenna arrays, beamforming, or RIS, and Fig. 1 (p. 2) shows single UEs and one access point. It does report quantitative results (Table I p. 3, Fig. 2 p. 4), so check 7 would not apply.
